newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar edges higher by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar edges higher by close.

text.p: White sugar remained handcuffed in tight ranges by the close of Monday's business, though prices closed higher on a late flurry of broker covering.
March last traded $1.00 higher at $304.00, while May ticked up by $1.10 from Friday's close to 304.90.
Overall volume remained light at 796 lots.

Traders said London's forward months struggled to regain its normal backwardation amid a lack of fresh fundamental news, while crossed and against actuals March trades mainly concluded by commission houses comprising the bulk of the activity. Earlier weakness was partially offset by limited trade buying and a firmer New York performance.
Traders noted industrial users were deterred from making spot purchases by the flat spreads and were waiting for lower prices.
Physical news was thin, though Zimbabwe is thought to have bought 28,000 tonnes of raw sugar for January/February from a London-based trade house at an undisclosed price.
